user.title: Connect to InfoMentor
user.description: Paste an OAuth2 refresh token from the InfoMentor Hub mobile grant. See the integration README for how to create your own token.

children.title: Choose children
children.description: Select which linked children should get entities in Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Refresh token rejected
reauth_confirm.description: InfoMentor no longer accepts the stored refresh token. Paste a newly created token to resume updates.

error.wrong_account: That token belongs to a different InfoMentor account.

abort.already_configured: This InfoMentor account is already configured.
abort.reauth_failed: Could not find the entry to reauthenticate.
